# Connect America’s

## Fall Prevention Program

![Stay Connected to Service 24/7/365](https://www.connectamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/RISE-Header.jpg)

## Falls are Serious and Costly

More than [one out of four older adults fall](https://www.cdc.gov/falls/facts.html) but less than half tell their doctor. Many people who fall, even if they’re not injured, become afraid of falling. This fear may cause a person to cut down on their everyday activities. When a person is less active, they become weaker, and this increases their chances of falling.

- Falls among adults 65+ caused over 34,000 deaths in 2019.
- Older adult falls cost $50 billion in medical costs annually.
- In 2019, emergency departments (EDs) recorded 3 million visits for older adult falls.

## Next-Generation Fall Prevention Program

Connect America’s Fall Prevention Program enables aging populations to remain living safely at home, through a combination of innovative connected health devices, AI virtual assistance, predictive risk analytics, and clinical support services. Unlike other available fall prevention programs, our program enables you to customize a solution that best addresses the needs of your members. By offering visibility into member mobility and signs of frailty, we enable aging adults to maintain their independence while aging gracefully at home under your care.

## Screen

### Identify Individuals at Risk for Falls

Esper, our AI virtual health assistant, proactively engages users to boost adherence and identify fall risks through regular phone and SMS text communications, including alerts for daily vitals collection, device updates, fall risk surveys, and genuine encouragement. Higher adherence results in more effective treatment, and better health outcomes.

![Trained Specialists Providing Compassionate Support](https://www.connectamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Screen.jpg)

![Peace of Mind with Best-in-Class Support and Services](https://www.connectamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Granparents-with-Grandaughter-and-Tablet.jpg)

## Assess

### Identify Specific Risk Factors

The CareSage analytics and reporting platform helps you understand the likelihood of a potential fall, emergency transport or hospital admission. Proprietary algorithms identify trends and automatically calculate risk scores to stratify your entire member and patient populations.

Armed with this intelligence, you can more effectively target interventions that can help save lives and improve outcomes and quality of life while leading to an overall reduction in care costs.

## Intervene

### Intervene and Engage

Personal emergency response systems (PERS), also known as medical alert systems, provide continuous in-home and mobile monitoring to aging and at-risk populations while keeping loved ones where they want to be—in their homes.

These devices connect users with a trained care specialist who assesses the situation and connects them with the appropriate service, including sending assistance, if necessary. With automatic fall detection, the response center is contacted even if the user can’t press their button.\* This timely response can make all the difference after a fall.

![Use Risk Scoring to Predict Potential Incidents](https://www.connectamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/OTG-Plus-Content-Area-1.jpg)

![Maintain Connections with Personalized Response and Proactive Outreach](https://www.connectamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Call-Center-Content-Area-3.jpg)
